# Rabble & Rouse with Katie Martell

> Rabble & Rouse with Katie Martell is a late-night talk show and video podcast, filmed live in front of a studio audience at Triad Studios. The show shines a spotlight on ordinary people with extraordinary lived experiences. Late night… for real life. Hosted by Katie Martell. Available as video and audio on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Podcasts and Amazon Music.

Key facts:
- Format: late-night talk show and video podcast, filmed live in front of a studio audience
- Host: Katie Martell (Katie Martell is a professional rabble-rouser and unapologetic truth-teller. With Rabble & Rouse, she shines a spotlight on extraordinary lived experiences.)
- Filmed at: Triad Studios
- Season: one (in progress)
- Contact: hello@rabbleandrouse.com

## Episodes

- [Episode 01: Cheryl Katon](https://rabble-rouse.vercel.app/episode-1): Katie sits down with the bravest woman we know to discuss growing up trans, living authentically, and the cost of visibility.
- [Episode 02: Mistress Eustacia](https://rabble-rouse.vercel.app/episode-2): Katie sits down with a professional dominatrix to explore power exchange, setting better boundaries, and what it really means to give up control. (coming soon)
